description: Revisor run 01M1HKRE686W833SE86D8WD319 (7 cycles, 2026-09-02): the analyzer distilled findings without seeing the tracker — the file stage had to merge/skip near-duplicates of OPEN seeds in 4 of 7 cycles (fabro-83f9 preamble budget, fabro-886e, fabro-2c81, the fabro-6a77/696c publish family). Root cause: analyze.md had no tracker-check step AND fs_hide covered .seeds from file tools (sd via shell was available but never instructed). Aggravator: backlog runs share era root causes, so identical themes re-distilled every pass. Fix (816d44e67): analyzer loads the tracker FIRST (sd list + sd search per theme), drops concrete-change duplicates with duplicate_of <id> (open = duplicate, closed = already implemented), names drops in the journal; file stays the race/content-dup guard. Lesson generalizes: every distilling agent stage needs the 'what already exists' input named in its prompt — dedup at the consumer wastes a stage and risks title-blind misses.
resolution: analyze.md tracker pre-check landed with the next workflow version; the running revision pass completes on the old pinned version (immutable at admission).
